parse_orders_from_text: parse a string of DIP orders into a dictionary mapping powers to their normalized orders
parse_test_from_html: parse a single DATC test HTML snippet into its name, description, orders, and result string
parse_tests_from_html_file: parse all DATC tests from an HTML file and return a list of parsed test tuples
run_interactive_test_collector: run the interactive CLI to collect user inputs for DATC test move outcomes with caching
review_parse_orders_normalization: review the parse_orders function to understand how it normalizes SUPPORTS, CONVOYS, BUILD, DISBAND, and REMOVE keywords
